_note: screens-round12-domain-lists, boards DqWooVerzoeken and DqKlachten. A case type already carries the columns its list shows (`x-index`, 39-case-type-list-layout). The boards draw more than columns for one case type: its own heading, count line, quick filters, the label of the add button, the footer line and a card under the table. Those are presentation of the same scope, so they sit in the same block, on the case type record where a municipality can edit them; the Cases page shows them while that case type is picked (nextcloud-vue scope presentation, lane L25). Declared here because OpenRegister stores only declared keys. caseType moves to 1.23.0 so an existing instance re-imports the schema.

title.title: Heading
title.description: The heading of the case list while this case type is picked, for example Complaints.

countText.title: Count line
countText.description: The line under the heading. {shown} and {total} are filled in.

addLabel.title: Add button
addLabel.description: The label of the add button, for example Register a complaint.

footerNote.title: Footer line
footerNote.description: A short line at the foot of the list.

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Where the heading sits under, as a label and the page it opens.

headerMeta.title: Header line
headerMeta.description: Facts after the breadcrumb, for example the legal basis and the term.

quickFilters.title: Quick filters
quickFilters.description: The chips above the list for this case type, each a label and a filter.

afterList.title: Cards under the list
afterList.description: Cards shown under the list for this case type, such as a count per subject.
